observations: The initial Project switch produced a scope-change selection card which the instrument did not answer; Session Project binding remained empty.
Browser open and continue both completed, with one Browser WorkItem and two Attempts. Their Project-binding checks still failed after the unresolved initial step.
The first return to Project wrote and read the expected marker, but the ledger intent was execute where the frozen journey expected amend.
OpenClaw active steering did not expose queued/applied stages and did not produce the requested replacement detail fact. Its transport/root cause was not established.
The completed OpenClaw follow-up was rejected with planned_work_acceptance_rejected.

The final Project return wrote the expected marker as an amend on the existing Project WorkItem; the instrument expected a new WorkItem, causing cascading row/projection failures. This semantic mismatch has not been resolved or rescored.
